name: SmartStop Self Storage
notes: Researched from the public SmartStop FAQ, mobile-app page and My Account log-in page (no sign-in). My Account menu: Login, Create Account, Make a Payment, Storage, Account Info, Payment History, Logout. Creating an account needs the Storage Account Number. The rendered log-in form shows Email and Password fields (observed by reviewer). Payments: online (My Account > Storage > Make Payment, or Pay All Units), phone with a card only and a $10 convenience fee (888-977-8672), or in person (cash/check/card, no fee). The phone fee is not an online fee and is described in help only. SmartPay automatic payments can be enrolled in the app, or with an automatic-payment form from the property manager; no cancel route is described (autopay_cancel unsupported, inferred). E-bills are "in development"; monthly emailed invoices on request from the store manager (paperless unsupported). Partial payments and payment plans are not accepted; late fees cannot be waived and vary by state. Move-out: 10 days' written or verbal notice to the property manager or call center. Reviewer 2026-10-09: the My Account menu has separate "Storage" and "Account Info" items (not "Storage Account Info"); profile label fixed; sign-in identifier now observed.

autopay.note: Enroll in SmartPay in the SmartStop app, or ask your property manager for an automatic payment form.

autopay_cancel.note: SmartStop does not describe turning off automatic payments online; ask your property manager or call (888) 977-8672.

paperless.note: E-bills are not available yet. Ask your store manager to set up monthly invoices by email.

payment_arrangement.note: SmartStop does not accept partial payments or offer payment plans; the full balance is due.

cancel_service.note: Give at least 10 days' written or verbal notice to your property manager or the call center at (888) 977-8672, then empty the unit and remove your lock.

pay_by_phone.note: Card payments only, with a $10 convenience fee.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Paying online is the preferred way: log in to My Account, open Storage and choose Make Payment for a unit, or Pay All Units to pay every unit at once.
You can also pay by phone at (888) 977-8672 with a debit or credit card (Mastercard, Visa, Discover or American Express) for a $10 convenience fee, or in person with cash, check or card at no charge.
steps: Choose Make Payment (or Pay All Units).
Enter your payment details and submit.

help.title: SmartPay automatic payments
paragraphs: You can enroll in SmartPay automatic payments in the SmartStop app. Your property manager can also give you an automatic payment form to fill out and return.

help.title: Late rent
paragraphs: Rent is due on the anniversary date of your rental. After a grace period set by your state's lien law and listed in your lease, a late fee is charged that cannot be waived.
Partial payments and payment plans are not accepted. Past-due units can lose gate access and be over-locked, and may eventually be sold at an online auction under state law.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: Give at least 10 days' written or verbal notice to your property manager or the call center at (888) 977-8672. Empty the unit, remove your lock and move out by your date; the manager inspects the unit before it is marked vacant.

help.title: Payment history and invoices
paragraphs: In the app, tap Account and then Payment History to see the past 12 months of payments; you can email a receipt to the address on your account.
E-bills are still in development. If you want a monthly invoice by email, ask your store manager to set it up.
